title: Free time at home
descriptionFa: سرگرمی‌ها، خوندنی‌ها، و کارهایی که توی خونه با دوستات می‌کنی.

words.example: My hobby is taking photos of old buildings.
My favourite TV programme is about wild animals.
Put on your headphones, please. I'm trying to sleep.
My little brother wants to play video games all day.
I find new recipes on the Internet.
words.tipFa: با the: on the Internet. خیلی‌ها با i کوچیک هم می‌نویسن.

words.example: I chat online with my cousins in Germany.
My father's hobby is cooking Iranian food.
My grandmother spends hours gardening every spring.
We grow tomatoes and mint in our garden.
words.tipFa: معنی «رشد کردن» هم می‌ده. گذشته: grew.

words.example: I'm reading a novel by Simin Daneshvar.
This comic has great pictures but not many words.
She reads a fashion magazine every month.
My grandfather reads the newspaper with his breakfast.
We often have friends round on Thursday evenings.
words.tipFa: برای شام: have friends to dinner.

words.example: My cousins come to stay every summer.
My sister is always on the phone!
words.tipFa: با کسی تلفنی حرف زدن: talk to someone on the phone.

words.example: On Fridays I like to do nothing at all.
The baby usually needs to have a sleep after his bath.
